item_name: Rothco Don't Tread On Me Round Morale Patch
item_short_desc: The Rothco Round "Don't Tread on Me" Morale Patch features a snake with the embroidered text "Don't Tread on Me" around the image.
description: The Rothco Round "Don't Tread on Me" Morale Patch features a snake with the embroidered text "Don't Tread on Me" around the image. The patches feature a hook backing which makes it ideal for attaching to our Special Ops Jackets, Transport Packs, Tactical Vest and more. Patches with the item #’s starting with ‘P’ are individually packaged with a header card.
